name: Group Splash – Team Introducer
author: samiur6688

sections.description:
Group Splash – Team Introducer is a lightweight WordPress plugin that allows you to create and manage your team members. Each team member can have a profile image, name, description, and up to four social media links. The plugin provides an easy-to-use admin interface and allows you to display your team in a responsive grid on any page or post using the [groupsplash_shortcode].

Key Features

  • Team Member Management: Add, edit, and remove team members directly from the WordPress dashboard.
  • Social Media Links: Store up to four social media profiles per team member.
  • Responsive Grid Display: Use the [groupsplash_shortcode] on pages and posts.
  • Featured Images and Descriptions: Each member can have a profile image, name, and detailed description.
  • Shortcode Support: [groupsplash_shortcode] works on pages and posts.

Supported Social Media Icons

This plugin uses icons from the Font Awesome library.

The following social media platforms are currently supported:

  • Behance
  • CodePen
  • DeviantArt
  • Digg
  • Docker
  • Dribbble
  • Dropbox
  • Facebook
  • Flickr
  • Foursquare
  • Pocket
  • GitHub
  • Instagram
  • LinkedIn
  • Medium
  • Pinterest
  • Periscope
  • Reddit
  • Skype
  • SlideShare
  • Snapchat
  • SoundCloud
  • Spotify
  • StumbleUpon
  • Telegram
  • TikTok
  • Tumblr
  • Twitch
  • X (Twitter)
  • Vimeo
  • Vine
  • VK
  • WhatsApp
  • WordPress
  • Yelp
  • YouTube

Icons are automatically displayed based on your selection in the admin panel.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/group-splash-team-introducer directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Group Splash in the WordPress dashboard to add your team members and social media links.
  4. Display your team anywhere using [groupsplash_shortcode].
sections.faq:
How many social media links can I add per member?

You can add up to four social media links per team member.

Can I use this plugin without coding?

Yes. Simply add team members in the dashboard and insert [groupsplash_shortcode] wherever you want to display them.

Do I need to add icons manually?

No. You only need to choose the social platform and provide the link. The plugin automatically displays the corresponding icon using Font Awesome.
